'''Nanta''' was an [[Ewok]] in the [[Bright Tree tribe]] of the [[moon]] [[Endor]]. In [[4 ABY]], Nanta was part of a [[scout]]ing party that discovered a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebel]] offworlders caught in one of their net traps. Surrounding the offworlders, the Ewoks disarmed them, with Nanta taking the [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]]'s [[bowcaster]]. Nanta and the other Ewoks then fell to their knees and prayed to the [[protocol droid]] [[C-3PO]], mistaking him for the [[deity]] known as the [[Golden One]].

In his childhood, Nanta failed at most of Ewok activities: making spears and knowing the berries and plants of [[Endor]]. However his mind wondered about things in the stars. During a confrontation with [[Logray]] in a class to identify plants, Logray identifies how Nanta would be a great story-keeper. Nanta chooses then to start writing stories on a puny tree near the village. 

The scouting party brought the offworlders back to [[Bright Tree Village]], where they were eventually accepted as members of the tribe. The Ewoks then agreed to help them [[Battle of Endor|fight]] the [[Galactic Empire]] on Endor. The next [[Standard day|day]], the Ewoks led the rebels to a [[Endor shield generator bunker|Imperial shield bunker]] which the offworlders infiltrated; however, after the rebels were captured in an Imperial trap, the Ewoks attacked the [[Imperial Military|Imperial forces]] at the bunker. In the ensuing battle, Nanta was [[Death|fatally]] wounded by a shot from an [[All Terrain Scout Transport]]. The Ewok's friend [[Romba]] knelt beside his fallen comrade and hugged the dying Nanta.

==Biography==
===Finding a god===
{{Quote|Chewie, give them your crossbow.|Luke Skywalker tells Chewbacca to surrender his weapon to Nanta|<ref name="ROTJ" />}}
Nanta<ref name="Red5" /> was an [[Ewok]] member<ref name="ROTJ" /> of the [[Bright Tree tribe]]<ref name="Darkside">''[[Return of the Jedi: Beware the Power of the Dark Side!]]''</ref> that lived in<ref name="ROTJ" /> [[Bright Tree Village]]<ref name="USW" /> on the [[forest]] [[moon]] of [[Endor]]. In [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> He<ref name="Red5" /> was part of<ref name="ROTJ" /> a [[scout]]ing party that the [[warrior]] [[Teebo]]<ref name="USW">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref> led out from the village into the forest. The party came upon a group of offworlders who had been caught in one of the Ewoks' net traps, hiding in the undergrowth around the trap as the captives freed themselves from the dangling net and fell to the forest floor. Nanta and the other Ewoks then emerged from the foliage, surrounding the offworlders. The Ewoks then disarmed them at [[spear]]point, with Nanta trying to take the [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]]'s [[bowcaster]]. The pair intiailly wrestled over the weapon until the [[Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker]] told Chewbacca to hand the bowcaster over, at which point the Wookiee let Nanta take it.<ref name="ROTJ" />

The offworlders' [[protocol droid]], [[C-3PO]], then sat up for the first [[time]] in front of the Ewoks, who mistook the [[droid]] for the [[deity]] known as the [[Golden One]]. Falling to their [[Limb|knees]], Nanta and the other Ewoks bowed repeatedly before C-3PO while chanting. They reared up, weapons ready again, when the droid's companion [[Han Solo]] made to lunge at him, after which the scouting party brought the offworlders back to Bright Tree Village. C-3PO was borne aloft on a wooden throne while the others were bound to wooden frames and carried. At the village, the offworlders were eventually freed and then made members of the tribe after C-3PO told stories of their [[Galactic Civil War|fight]] against the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="ROTJ" />

===One of the fallen===
[[File:Corpsey.jpg|thumb|left|260px|Romba mourns his fallen friend.]]
[[Chief]] [[Chirpa]] declared that the Bright Tree tribe would aid the offworlders, who were members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]], in fighting the Empire and the following [[Standard day|day]], the Ewoks showed the rebels the location of a back entrance into an [[Endor shield generator bunker|Imperial shield bunker]] that they were searching for on the moon. The rebels then infiltrated the bunker, but fell into a trap and were escorted back outside into a large gathering of [[Imperial Military|Imperial forces]]. An [[army]] of Ewoks then attacked the Imperials from the surrounding [[bush]]es, allowing the rebels to fight alongside them as a [[Battle of Endor|battle]] broke out.<ref name="ROTJ" />

During the fighting, Nanta and<ref name="ROTJ" /> [[Romba]], a [[Soldier|warrior]] and friend of Nanta,<ref name="ROTJ AD">{{Film|VI}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> rushed together through the undergrowth as an<ref name="ROTJ" /> [[All Terrain Scout Transport]] fired upon them.<ref name="Red5" /> One of the shots impacted next to the pair, knocking both to the ground.<ref name="ROTJ" /> Nanta was fatally wounded by the shot,<ref name="ROTJ AD" /> and rocked back on forth briefly on the ground before falling still. Romba then rolled over and stood, trying to pull Nanta with<ref name="ROTJ" /> him,<ref name="ROTJ AD" /> but the other Ewok did not stir. Speaking to Nanta in [[Ewokese]], Romba shook the fallen Ewok, but when he still did not respond, the warrior fell to his knees<ref name="ROTJ" /> and began to mourn,<ref name="Red5" /> hugging his dying friend.<ref name="ROTJ AD" /> The Ewoks and rebels would go on to defeat the Empire on Endor, destroying the bunker and then destroying the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|Death Star II]] [[superweapon]] it had been protecting in orbit above.<ref name="ROTJ" /> In the end, his story would be transformed into a ballad by Romba, [[The Ballad of Nanta|"The Ballad of Nanta".]] 

==Personality and traits==
Nanta had striped [[Color|gray]] and black [[Hair|fur]] and brown [[eye]]s.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Equipment==
Nanta wore a brown [[Clothing|hood]] and carried a spear while in the scouting party.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|For years, the Ewok slain by AT-AT blaster fire on the forest moon of Endor was referred to simply by the ''Tales from the Crypt''-esque name "Corpsey," primarily because… well, what else are you going to call a dead Ewok?|Joe Schreiber|<ref name="Red5" />}}
Nanta first appeared in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="ROTJ" /> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the character was identified in an interview with author [[Joe Schreiber]] in the "[[Red Five (department)|Red Five]]" department of [[Star Wars Insider 150|''Star Wars Insider'' 150]],<ref name="Red5" /> which released on [[June 10]], [[2014]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-insider-150-lego-covers-exclusive-reveal|text=Star Wars Insider #150 LEGO Covers – Exclusive Reveal!|nolive=1}}</ref> The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first used for a [[2012]] [[Hasbro]] figure of the [[Nanta/Legends|Ewok]].<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Movie Heroes|pack=Ewok Pack|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/Ewok_Pack_2012_Star_Wars_Movie_Heroes_Hasbro.asp}}</ref> Prior to this, the fallen Ewok was nicknamed "Corpsey" by fans.<ref name="Red5" /> Author [[Benjamin Harper]] regretted not establishing whether the Ewok was called "Lana" or not in the [[2008]] book ''[[Obsessed With Star Wars]]'', as Harper believed that this was what<ref name="Obssessed">{{SWArchive|url=vault/books/20080808news.html|text=Obsessing Over ''Obsessed With Star Wars''}}</ref> Romba says as the other Ewok tries to pull Nanta from the ground.<ref name="ROTJ" />
